name: fbi-letter-shift
plaintext: Meet me at the park at noon
ciphertext: Nffu nf bu uif qbsl bu oppo
note: Verification certificate for a published worked example of the FBI one-letter right shift (Help Solve an Open Murder Case, Part 2, Internet Archive capture of the 2011-04-05 FBI page: ciphertext Nffu nf bu uif qbsl bu oppo, every character shifted one letter to the right, plaintext Meet me at the park at noon). Known-answer check only. Not an unknown-script reading. Not a reading of Linear A, Indus, Voynich, rongorongo, Kryptos K4, or army message Nr. 86. Not a reading of the unsolved notes in the same FBI article.
